legend.title: Gamification of Learning, Education, Work, and Life
legend.subtitle: Unlocking human potential through innovative technology, human-centered AI, and engaging experiences.
legend.description: Transform how humanity learns, works, and lives to unlock better outcomes across learning, work, health, and life. We empower people to understand the game they're playing, master their real-life controller, and unlock their full potential.

primaryGoal.title: Build a Trillion-Dollar Education Empire
primaryGoal.description: Create transformative AI-powered education and productivity tools that scale globally, empowering millions of learners to unlock their full potential, master their real-life controller and character, understand the game they are playing, and improve their lives.
